name: KUB-StoneX (Daffodil International University HIRL)
what: 2,570 AP kidney-ureter-bladder radiographs of 1,703 patients from two Bangladeshi hospitals, with pixel-level stone masks and radiomic features; a KUB film is a frontal lumbar spine and pelvis radiograph at abdominal exposure, with the iliac crests and the sacrum in field
level_truth: none; frontal lumbar spine and pelvis
status: found by the sweep of 2026-10-21; not fetched; public per the listing, the licence and the download route to confirm on the page; the frontal counterpart of what the registry lacks in volume
how_to_get: Open https://hirl.daffodilvarsity.edu.bd/dataset/ and read the licence and the download route; where a form is asked for, the owner fills it.
Fetch as a Slurm job on the owner's word, never on the login node: python3 data/reproduce/reacquire/reacquire.py http-get --url U --dest FILE, U being the address the page gives.
